info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Treasury By Param1-spec
info.description: The Treasury Portfolio Query API allows users to access detailed treasury information based on a specific parameter. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts and banking professionals looking to retrieve data related to treasury management and bank portfolio administration. By providing a variable parameter, consumers can easily filter and access relevant financial portfolios for analysis or reporting. This streamlined access to treasury data supports better decision-making and operational efficiency within banking environments.

get.summary: Retrieve bank portfolio details by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific bank portfolio by its unique identifier (RES-100045). It provides essential data related to the portfolio's status, holdings, and transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to bank portfolio administration under the specified resource. It requires a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema corresponding to the operation.
